Uniform ✈️ (set is from New Yorker, I have it in 3 colors)

My +1 everywhere I go ✈️👧🏻

Turkeys are actually quite intimidating 🦃😅

I’ve never met anyone with a purer heart than hers 🦋

The only time I will ever sit in the drivers seat 😂 Adobe 💅

Generation of Makhana toddlers 🙈😅

My ultimate fantasy is to be left in a hotel room uninterrupted 💅

Boojee has been my saving grace more times than you know, the only cafe I will ever go to in Mumbai ☕️

Lil munchkin @hustlerani 🌸

Vada Pav? YES please 👅🤤

Beginning stages of something SO exciting 👏🏼

After a chaotic day, we need each other 🫂

We love working out no matter where in the world we are 😛😍

Squishy hugs for these cuties! 🥹😍 @komalpandeyofficial @siddharth93batra

Gorgeous mama’s 🌸💗 @juhigodambe

Veronica + Dyson is the reason for those fab pictures by the way! 💅😅".
